s.zh: \n每天自然恢复10点；心情≥80%时每天再恢复10点；每击杀一个敌人+5。\n神罚消耗30，神裔之息消耗40。
s.en: \nRecovers 10 per day naturally; another 10 per day when mood ≥80%; +5 per enemy killed.\nDivine punishment costs 30, divine kin's breath costs 40.

s.zh: 开局的泰坦近战与社交都很出色；开局就认下一位父神（七位可信奉的神里随机），泰坦觉醒之路已经开启。
s.en: The starting titan excels at melee and social; it starts with a sire god acknowledged (random among the seven worshippable gods), and the path of titan awakening is already open.

s.zh: 从天穹坠落时，还记得父神的名字：
s.en: still remembered the sire god's name when falling from the heavens:

s.zh: \n\n泰坦觉醒之路已经开启（推荐路线）。选中
s.en: \n\nThe path of titan awakening is open (recommended path). Select
and click "path to godhood" to view progress:\n\n

s.zh: \n\n之后是巨人之战和天穹之门，完成后直接觉醒为半神。不想走这条路，可以在窗口里放弃。
s.en: \n\nNext come the war of giants and the Gate of the Heavens, after which they awaken directly as a demigod. If you don't want this path, you can abandon it in the window.

s.zh: \n\n成神任务线在设置里关着：父神已经记下，打开后再踏上泰坦觉醒之路时还是这位。
s.en: \n\nThe ascension questline is off in settings: the sire god is recorded, and will still be this one when the path of titan awakening is taken after turning it on.
